title: MATHMIST: A Parallel Multilingual Benchmark Dataset for Mathematical Problem Solving and Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing LLM accuracy on a parallel multilingual mathematical reasoning benchmark (MATHMIST) across seven languages of varying resource levels (high, medium, low). The methodology includes measuring performance disparities in zero-shot, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), and code-switched prompting scenarios to quantify the degradation of reasoning capabilities in low-resource and non-English languages.
